title: Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

Hays are partnering with a growing and ambitious organisation based in Newquay to recruit a Finance Coordinator on an ongoing temporary basis.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a modern business during a busy period of growth, working within a supportive finance team where you'll play a key role in maintaining efficient financial operations and supporting ongoing business success.

Your new role

As a Finance Coordinator, you'll provide essential support across a broad range of finance activities while working closely with the Finance Manager and wider business.Responsibilities will include:
- Managing supplier relationships and resolving invoice queries
- Coordinating weekly and monthly payment runs
- Reconciling supplier statements and bank accounts
- Assisting with cashflow reporting and forecasting
- Supporting month-end activities, including journals and reconciliations
- Producing financial reports and analysis for management
- Monitoring outstanding payments and investigating discrepancies
- Supporting finance process improvements and controls
- Assisting with ad-hoc finance projects as required

What you'll need to succeed
To be successful in this role, you'll have previous experience in a finance or accounts position and enjoy working within a fast-paced environment.
You'll ideally have:
- Experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Coordinator, Accounts Payable or Finance Assistant role
- Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good working knowledge of Excel and finance systems
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- A proactive approach and willingness to support the wider team
- The ability to manage competing priorities effectively

What you'll get in return
- Competitive hourly rate of £18.00 - £21.00 per hour
- Flexible working arrangements
- Immediate start available
- Friendly and collaborative team environment
- Exposure to a varied finance role with broad responsibilities
- Opportunity to develop your skills within a growing organisation
- Potential for contract extension and longer-term opportunities

What you need to do nowIf you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
